The build is complete and verified. Here's the acceptance report.

## Your bookmark manager is built and ready to review

**Open it at:** http://maker:4000 — it starts on a clean, empty library (your real first-run), and since it's a live app you can paste in real links and watch the details fill in automatically.

### What was built
Everything we agreed, implemented fresh from the behaviours you approved (25 scenarios) — saving with automatic details, tags & Markdown notes, editing everything later, read-later/archive, powerful search + tag filter + saved searches, sorting, bulk actions, full-page & PDF copies plus Internet Archive, browser import/export, display preferences with paging, and all the empty/error/duplicate/overflow cases.

### Verification — passed
- **Behaviour (acceptance) tests: 35/35 passed.** An automated browser drives the real app through every approved scenario — saving, the duplicate-and-edit flow, the unreadable-page fallback, the full search grammar (phrases, `#tag`, AND/OR/NOT, graceful fallback), read-later/archive, delete-with-undo, bulk actions, snapshots, Internet Archive, import (preserving titles/dates/tags), export, preferences and paging.
- **Internal tests: 34/34 passed.** Covering the search engine, Markdown renderer, import/export, and all the data operations against a controlled test site.
- **Live check:** a real save of a public page fetched its title correctly, with no errors.
- During testing I found and fixed two genuine defects: duplicate-detection was ignoring query strings, and the search highlighter mis-handled single-letter terms — both corrected and re-verified.

A couple of honesty notes: the automatic details, page snapshots, and Internet Archive step reach out to the live internet, so their results depend on the target site and that service being reachable; when something can't be fetched, the app saves the link anyway and lets you retry, exactly as we agreed.

**Do you accept this software as the completion of this cycle, on the basis of the behaviour we approved and the verification above?** If anything doesn't match what we approved, tell me and I'll correct it within this cycle; anything that would change or extend an approved behaviour I'll record for a future cycle.
